name: Magnet Piano
description: A piano whose strings are sung by magnets instead of struck: notes swell out of nothing, glassy and pure, on whichever harmonic of the string the magnets feed, with a soft felt hammer to taste.

params.name: Bloom
params.description: How long a note takes to swell under the magnets. Short speaks like an organ; long rises out of silence. The low harmonics of a string arrive after its high ones.

params.name: Harmonic
params.description: Which harmonic of the string the magnets feed, from the note itself to three octaves above. Between two, both sound. The high ones are a little sharp, as a string's are.

params.name: Bright
params.description: How many harmonics around the fed one join in. At zero a note is one pure tone; higher, its neighbours come up and the sound fills out.

params.name: Hammer
params.description: A soft felt strike at the start of each note, like a muted piano, that rings and fades under the swell. At zero there is no strike at all.

params.name: Shimmer
params.description: How far apart the three strings of each note are tuned. More makes them beat against each other faster, and move between left and right.

params.name: Sweep
params.description: How far the fed harmonic wanders up and down on its own. Every held note takes its own path, so a chord keeps changing colour.

params.name: Sweep rate
params.description: How fast the fed harmonic wanders. Slow is a tide over many seconds; fast is a ripple through the overtones. It does nothing while Sweep is at zero.

params.name: Sympathy
params.description: How much the strings of the other held notes ring along where their harmonics match, so chords glow. It does nothing while only one note sounds.

params.name: Damper
params.description: How long a note takes to stop once the key is let go. Short is a damper falling on the strings; long lets them ring on.

params.name: Body
params.description: The colour of the soundboard. At zero you hear the bare string, glassy and open; higher is warmer and woodier, with a softer top.

params.name: Width
params.description: How far the outer two strings of each note sit to the left and right. At zero the instrument is mono.

params.name: Volume
params.description: Output level of the instrument. A soft clip after it rounds off the peaks when many notes stack up.

origin.note: Written for live-mix on cpp/kit. It models piano strings driven into sustained vibration by electromagnets: three strings per note as a bank of stretched partials, a drive that favours one harmonic, an optional felt strike and a soundboard colour. The strings are sine partials with envelopes and the soundboard is a gain per partial; it is not a model of any one instrument or product.
